candidate_risk.reason: Native approach timing and the source-camera coverage of the nearest through-highway view may drift during physical capture.

trigger.source: original Native approach-history body centres and map lane projection
trigger.metric: distance from ego spawn to nearest sourced through-highway view point
trigger.failure_condition: Source history has too few pre-view approach samples to establish the planned slowdown or stop

changed_knobs: ego spawn x: -60 m to -66 m on the same authored approach lane
candidates.remedy: Give the same controlled response six additional metres of approach while retaining case, actor, sign, through traffic, cameras and capture contract.

trigger.source: four original camera streams and timestamp-joined through-highway sight rays
trigger.metric: fraction of nearest-view frames with visible sign and through approach in the source camera
trigger.failure_condition: Approach camera misses either the yield sign or through-highway target at the sourced nearest-view interval

candidates.remedy: Raise and reposition only the fixed approach camera to cover the same sign and through-lane view; preserve its name, dimensions, FOV, frame rate and capture duration.

changed_knobs: ego speed-controller gain: 0.25 to 0.30, preserving target speeds and through-actor controller
